Convert mapping list to data frame

Source: R/list_to_data_frame.R
list_to_data_frame.Rd

Convert mapping list to data frame

Usage

list_to_data_frame(l, ...)

list_to_data_frame_(l, category = "category", item = "item")

Arguments

l

A named list of character vectors.

...

Unquoted names of category and item columns. Defaults to 'category' and 'item'.

category

Name of category column. Defaults to 'category'.

item

Name of item column. Defaults to 'item'.

Value

A data frame.

Author

Michaja Pehl

Examples

l <- list(Africa = c('Egypt', 'Tanzania'),
          Europe = c('Portugal', 'Ukraine', 'Denmark'))
list_to_data_frame(l, region, country)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 2
#>   region country 
#>   <chr>  <chr>   
#> 1 Africa Egypt   
#> 2 Africa Tanzania
#> 3 Europe Portugal
#> 4 Europe Ukraine 
#> 5 Europe Denmark
